motions.topic: Figure out the generation tier for a fully multi-modal platform: (1) TEXT — the native generator is the Mamba-3B forward (parity-correct), and its only defect is the 2-bit ternary quantization; the faithful path is to load the model at a fidelity that PRESERVES the argmax (fp16, which was already forced on the SSM tensors at 933 MB, extended to the whole model — or a higher-bit quant that keeps the top-5 logits), so the in-kernel forward becomes a real generator instead of a demoted verdict; the llama-server ternary-Bonsai-8B stays OUT of the answer path (no ollama, no external LLM) and is labeled a bounded experiment only. (2) MULTI-MODAL — image / audio / video generation are SEPARATE model additions (diffusion for image, vocoder/tts for audio) that this platform does not yet carry; the honest step is to scope them and name which modality comes first, not to claim they exist. The TEST is pre-registered: (1) the native Mamba forward at the higher fidelity recovers the reference argmax (7785 for 'The capital of France is') or enters its top-5, measured against the current ternary argmax 3003; and (2) the multi-modal roadmap names one concrete first modality with its model + a measured receipt. MEASURED (this host): the tier-2 generator at :8587 is llama-server serving Ternary-Bonsai-8B-Q2_0_g64.gguf (a 2-bit ternary quant — the SAME quantization that MOTION-M1 proved lossy: the Mamba-3B forward argmax was 3003 vs llama Q4 reference 7785, arithmetic parity exact but the 2-bit ternary loses the generation signal). The native Mamba-3B forward pass is parity-correct (A matrix, silu gate, conv direction, fp16 subnormals all fixed; top-5 logits match Python exactly). Ollama (:11434) is STOPPED (directive: no ollama). The embedder at :8588 is all-minilm (CPU). There is NO image, audio, or video generation tier anywhere in the kernel. MOTION-N1 already holds that the CPU is the model — intelligence is distilled, not a resident LLM. REJECT AS PREMATURE if the motion would wire the llama-server/Ollama back into the answer path (that reverses 'no ollama' and MOTION-N1), or if a modality is claimed without naming its model and a measured receipt.
